description: Pairwise sequence identity across the nine UbiB-family proteins to place ADCK1 relative to COQ8A, Cqd1 and Cqd2
code:
exec(open("lib.py").read())
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, json
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
seqs=load_seqs()
names=list(seqs.keys())
N=len(names); M=np.zeros((N,N))
for i in range(N):
    for j in range(N):
        M[i,j]=100.0 if i==j else pid(seqs[names[i]],seqs[names[j]])
df=pd.DataFrame(M,index=names,columns=names).round(1)
df.to_csv("ubib_pairwise_identity.csv")
print(df.to_string())
a=names.index("ADCK1_HUMAN")
print("\nADCK1 ranked partners:")
for j in np.argsort(-M[a]):
    if j!=a: print(f"  {names[j]:22s} {M[a,j]:5.1f}%")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(7.4,6.2))
im=ax.imshow(M,cmap="YlGnBu",vmin=8,vmax=55)
ax.set_xticks(range(N)); ax.set_xticklabels(names,rotation=90,fontsize=8)
ax.set_yticks(range(N)); ax.set_yticklabels(names,fontsize=8)
for i in range(N):
    for j in range(N):
        ax.text(j,i,f"{M[i,j]:.0f}",ha='center',va='center',fontsize=7.5,
                color='white' if M[i,j]>38 else '#222222')
ax.set_title("Full-length pairwise identity, UbiB family\n(Gotoh affine-gap, BLOSUM62, open -11 extend -1)",fontsize=10)
plt.colorbar(im,fraction=0.046,label="% identity")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
